status: Proposal only. No migration, grants, reader bypass, backfill or runtime activation implemented.
scope: One reviewed contract change set covering currently implemented connectors, with independent application commits. No seats, arbitrary connection cap or demo changes.
existingInfrastructureToReuse: EvidenceCandidate, source registry, evidence manifests, deterministic signals, existing source-aware citation validation
private.external_source_records and private.external_source_record_versions already carry immutable versions, normalized schema, temporal/accounting qualifiers and validation state
private.provider_entity_mappings already records verified mapping versions; its connection foreign keys and provider admission must be reviewed before reusing it for legacy connector stores
Existing Sheets read tickets, QBO protected authenticated browse, Square actor/session-protected saved-payment browse, approved file authority and approved-note loaders

proposedBoundaries.name: owner_only_existing_briefs
artifacts: reports weekly_briefing/monthly_briefing and trusted copies inheriting brief lineage
proposedBoundaries.rule: Active owner of the exact workspace, plus all existing privacy/source/session guards. Creator status supplies no exception; another active owner of that workspace may reuse an eligible brief.
proposedBoundaries.historicalImpact: No deletion, regeneration or invented lineage. Nonowners lose access. Ambiguous saved-copy lineage requires a metadata-only impact check and must fail closed.
proposedBoundaries.preserve: Trusted completion/failure transaction claims and triggers; existing actor-bound Sheets ticket and session checks; unrelated artifact policies. No new roles or seats.

proposedBoundaries.name: versioned_plugin_source_references
proposedBoundaries.serverResolution: Resolve exact authoritative originals and current connection/source lifecycle. Validate owner/session/workspace, provider policy, entity mapping and retained version. Never trust a caller-supplied eligible or scopeVerified flag.
proposedBoundaries.storage: Prefer references to existing immutable canonical source versions. For legacy snapshots/history, first establish version identity and current content verification; do not invent a UUID for composite keys or silently copy records into canonical storage.
proposedBoundaries.binding: A narrowly reviewed plugin-reference binder/validator complements the existing Sheets ticket. It must record every consumed original and revalidate before save/reopen. The existing UUID-table allowlist cannot represent the added stores and must not be broadly opened.
proposedBoundaries.failure: Unknown mapping, changed version, erased/disconnected source, unavailable authority or incomplete dependency group excludes that evidence or blocks saving; no refreshed-ticket fallback after generation.

proposedBoundaries.name: legacy_connector_entity_correspondence
proposedBoundaries.rule: Owner-confirmed exact account/entity/scope correspondence. Cross-workspace references rejected by constraints and protected reads. Connection replacement invalidates correspondence until verified. No automatic mapping from labels, creator, matching totals or workspace identity.
proposedBoundaries.designGate: Inspect existing mapping foreign keys and provider registry admission before deciding on a bridge or reuse; no duplicate canonical subsystem is authorized. Existing customer mappings are not changed automatically.

proposedBoundaries.name: complete_owner_bound_readers
proposedBoundaries.existing: Use authenticated reporting history/Wix invoker readers and current protected QBO/Square paths where their output and source authority are sufficient. Their signatures and grants are recorded in shared-evidence-contract-audit.json.
proposedBoundaries.loyverseZoho: Do not grant authenticated execution to existing service-only aggregates. Propose narrow authenticated owner/session-bound aggregate readers with explicit workspace/connection/date arguments, completeness, exact original-version references and no provider calls. Alternatively use existing RLS reads only if all-page completeness is proven within budget.
proposedBoundaries.lifecycle: The new readers must treat reauthorization/disconnected/stale/partial states explicitly and respect current revocation. No tokens, credential decryption, sync, import or provider refresh is part of reasoning.

runtimeWiringAfterContractReview.vsi: Protected adapters produce admitted shared evidence, then existing bounded businessSources and citation snapshots. Replace status-summary evidence only where exact originals are available; retain existing unsupported-source limitations.
runtimeWiringAfterContractReview.briefing: Same admitted evidence produces deterministic relationship signals with all original citations; project one canonical signal per claim without loosening relationship validation. Recheck file extraction authority and preserve approved notes as noncausal attributed context.
runtimeWiringAfterContractReview.budget: Keep existing 24-source/24000-character VSI envelope initially. Select whole dependency groups, deduplicate original identities, and report omissions. Recompute final serialized payload costs. No 5-provider or 10-connection product cap.
runtimeWiringAfterContractReview.savedOutputs: Use reviewed session-aware lifecycle patch; owner audience is enforced at the database and application boundaries. Reopen through original protected citation views, reporting changed/unavailable sources explicitly.

localQualification.implemented: 12 pure stored-output parsers/projections, two closed deterministic relationship recipes, complete dependency-group selection, VSI and briefing draft projectors, synthetic tests.
localQualification.notImplemented: New live readers/admission, immutable citation routes for additional providers, audience policy migration, source binding migration, canonical mapping writes, saved-output database integration, live model qualification.
localQualification.representative: Five plugins plus processed file and approved note; sixth-source and all-twelve cases; offset dates, currency partitions, different versions of a payment, incomplete coverage, mismatched entity/period/unit and full citation dependencies.
localQualification.testBoundary: JSON round-trip is a serialization check, not database persistence/reopening or real citation navigation. All projections are explicitly unadmitted and no application runtime imports them.
